task_name: FuXi-style cascade U-Transformer 15-day weather forecasting (analysis & demonstration)
named_methods: FuXi cascade of three U-Transformer models (short/medium/long-range members)
ERA5 reanalysis input at 0.25 deg (provided file is actually 1 deg / 181x360)
70-channel state: 5 upper-air vars (Z,T,U,V,R) at 13 pressure levels + 5 surface vars (T2M,U10,V10,MSL,TP)
Two consecutive 6-hour input states; 6-hour output cadence; horizon 15 days = 60 steps
explicit_outputs_requested: report/report.md with methodology, results, discussion, figures
Code in code/, intermediate results in outputs/
evaluation_axes: Comparison vs ECMWF ensemble mean (cited in task; not reproducible without their data)
limitations_to_state_in_report: Workspace ships only one init time (20231012-06) and one forecast lead (006.nc t+6h); 15-day rollout cannot be reproduced from scratch.
FuXi neural-network weights are not in workspace; we cannot retrain or run the actual U-Transformer cascade.
Provided data resolution is 1 deg (181x360), not the 0.25 deg stated in the task; we report on the data as provided.
ECMWF ensemble-mean trajectories are not in workspace; cited comparisons are taken from the literature (FuXi, FengWu, FourCastNet) and not reproduced.
Input fields are pre-standardized; absolute units cannot be recovered without the climatological mean/std files.
deliverable_strategy: Document the cascade methodology grounded in the FuXi paper as cited by the task and the related-work corpus (FourCastNet, FengWu, ML-vs-NWP), characterize the supplied data, diagnose the supplied 6h FuXi forecast, and illustrate the cascade error-growth rationale with a calibrated saturation model.
